svg.title: Tech stack
svg.desc: Languages: PHP 8.5, Rust, TypeScript, JavaScript, SQL. Frameworks: Pulsar, Laravel, Symfony, Vue.js. Data: PostgreSQL, MariaDB, MySQL, SQLite, Redis. Cloud and operations: AWS, Nginx, HTTP/3, Docker, GitHub Actions, Linux. Quality: PHPUnit, PHPStan max, Psalm, Infection. Security: OWASP Top 10, OAuth2 / OIDC, CSP, GDPR by design.
